pages.text: The crown is not growing from its head. The head is growing around the crown.
pages.title: The guardian
The Rootbound Guardian
pages.text: At the final checkpoint of Heart of the Thicket, a guardian takes shape. Defeat it, then use extraction to settle the campaign victory. Reaching the exit while it lives will not clear the dimension.

pages.title: The Rootbound Guardian
pages.text: The approach costs 25 tokens and requires Deep Salvage proof and an established campaign.

pages.title: Read the ember circle
pages.text: When the guardian roots itself and raises its arms, an ember circle marks its sweep. Leave the circle before the strike. Its exposed core takes extra damage during the windup: a chance to press your attack if you can still escape.

pages.title: Read the ember circle
pages.text: Below half health, its core flares. It alternates sweeps with smaller bursts marked beneath its target. Keep moving out of each new mark.

pages.title: Read the ember circle
pages.text: Every strike has a warning and recovery. It does not tear up the terrain.
Read the raised arms. Leave the marked ground before it strikes.
